title: 14-BCV-009 - Natural gas regulating and metering station buildings
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide, as stated by the STANDATA)
catalogue_status: Catalogue row is not marked [WITHDRAWN]; PDF carries an Archived watermark.

facts.text: The STANDATA addresses occupancy classification for buildings housing natural-gas regulating and metering equipment and cites ABC Sentence 6.2.2.5.(1) for air contaminants/ventilation.
facts.locator: 14-BCV-013 PDF, p.1, PURPOSE and CODE REFERENCES

facts.text: Group F, Division 2 classification is conditional on no more than 55 m² building area or one storey in height, low human occupancy, and sufficient ventilation to prevent small fitting leaks accumulating, with constant air movement.
